## JARVIS Alerts v1 - tells you on Telegram when something breaks
**Top:** any JARVIS workflow that fails sends its error here (each workflow: *Settings -> Error workflow -> JARVIS Alerts v1*). Same problem repeated within 60 min = one alert.
**Bottom:** every day 9:07 and Monday 10:40 (Toronto): checks the free AI, the voice service and that the Monday report went out. Silent when all is fine.
Credentials: **JARVIS Telegram** in both *Send* nodes, **OmniRoute** in *Check AI*. Save, then Publish. Alerts also go to the memory, so the JARVIS screen announces them.
